chapter.li: LEChapter33 Verse1 And now I, Nephi, cannot write all the things which were taught among my people, neither am I mighty in writing, like unto speaking; for when a man speaketh by the power of the holy ghost, the power of the holy ghost carrieth it unto the hearts of the children of men. VerseEnd Verse2 But behold, there are many that harden their hearts against the holy spirit, that it hath no place in them. Wherefore, they cast many things away which are written and esteem them as things of naught. VerseEnd Verse3 But I, Nephi, have written what I have written, and I esteem it as of great worth, and especially unto my people. For I pray continually for them by day, and mine eyes water my pillow by night because of them. And I cry unto my God in faith, and I know that he will hear my cry, VerseEnd Verse4 and I know that the Lord God will consecrate my prayers for the gain of my people. And the word which I have written in weakness will he make strong unto them, for it persuadeth men to do good. It maketh known unto them of their fathers, and it speaketh of Jesus and persuadeth men to believe in him and to endure to the end, which is life eternal. VerseEnd Verse5 And it speaketh harsh against sin according to the plainness of the truth; wherefore, no man will be angry at the words which I have written, save he shall be of the spirit of the Devil. VerseEnd Verse6 I glory in plainness; I glory in truth; I glory in my Jesus, for he hath redeemed my soul from hell. VerseEnd Verse7 I have charity for my people and great faith in Christ that I shall meet many souls spotless at his judgment seat. VerseEnd Verse8 I have charity for the Jew — I say Jew because I mean them from whence I came. VerseEnd Verse9 I also have charity for the gentiles. But behold, for none of these can I hope except they shall be reconciled unto Christ, and enter into the narrow gate, and walk in the straight path which leads to life, and continue in the path until the end of the day of probation. VerseEnd

Verse10 And now my beloved brethren, and also Jew, and all 2PP ye ends of the earth, hearken unto these words and believe in Christ; and if 2PP ye believe not in these words, believe in Christ. And if 2PP ye shall believe in Christ, 2PP ye will believe in these words, for they are the words of Christ; and he hath given them unto me, and they teach all men that they should do good. VerseEnd Verse11 And if they are not the words of Christ, judge 2PP ye, for Christ will show unto 2PP you with power and great glory that they are his words at the last day. And 2PP you and I shall stand face to face before his bar, and 2PP ye shall know that I have been commanded of him to write these things, notwithstanding my weakness. VerseEnd Verse12 And I pray the Father in the name of Christ that many of us, if not all, may be saved in his kingdom at that great and last day. VerseEnd

Verse13 And now my beloved brethren, all those who are of the house of Israel, and all 2PP ye ends of the earth, I speak unto 2PP you as the voice of one crying from the dust. Farewell until that great day shall come. VerseEnd Verse14 And 2PP you that will not partake of the goodness of God, and respect the words of the Jews, and also my words, and the words which shall proceed forth out of the mouth of the Lamb of God, behold, I bid 2PP you an everlasting farewell, for these words shall condemn 2PP you at the last day. VerseEnd Verse15 For what I seal on earth shall be brought against 2PP you at the judgment bar, for thus hath the Lord commanded me and I must obey. Amen. VerseEnd
